notes.title: [Notice] Update Preview
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders:
This is an announcement from“Refight:Burning Engine”operation team. Recently, we have been devoted a lot of time to develop new systems and contents in our game, such as new UI, new vehicles, new maps, new gamemodes，vehicles’talent system, forging system. Some working progress has been made so far, we apologize that we will stop updating our steam version for a while, but we will keep the maintenance of our game and restoring the update as soon as possible . Thanks for your patience. We sincerely appreciate your great love and support for “Refight:Burning Engine”and always try to provide the best service we capable of.
Thank you.

If you have any questions or advice, please contact us or join in our official QQ: 629222611. 
Official Twitter: @BurningEngine
Official Facebook: 
https://www.facebook.com/Refight-Burning-Engine-541562256296443/?modal=admin_todo_tour
Official Website: http://be.fantiangame.com/

notes.title: 12.2 update note
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Maintenance time[/h1][/b]
12.2, 2020 12:00~16:00  Asia (UTC+8)
12.1, 2020 20:00~24:00   NA (UTC-8)

[b][h1]Update content：[/h1][/b]
1、Add the ability to sell all green equipment in a key in the warehouse.
2、Add a new training skip feature for beginners.
3、The original single player mode has been changed to single ranking. It can get rank, which is shared with the group. But its accumulated points rate is slightly lower than the group ranking.
4、Add single-player matching mode. It has lower equipment drops and wear and tear than single-person ranking, bu it does not get ranking and replenishment points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/f55e3aa1fb15c1aa17c17f84f6fe0a3de8a25475.png[/img]
5、The player's default warehouse capacity is increased to 60 squares, and the advanced account is increased by an additional 120 squares.
6、Optimizes the process of training nods.
7、Optimizes the difficulty of practical training.
8、Optimizes the mode selection interface.

If you get any bugs or suggestions,please leave your comments under the Steam community post or E-mail us:publish@fantiangame.com for further feedback.Thank you for your support.

notes.title: 11.25 update note
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Maintenance time[/h1][/b]
11.25, 2020 12:00~16:00  Asia (UTC+8)
11.24, 2020 20:00~24:00   NA (UTC-8)

[b][h1]Update content：[/h1][/b]
1、The new car M60A2 debut. Access and challenges can get a time-bound experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/6271094baa05a43751a5e15f6e1da13624c3a392.png[/img]
2、The addition of new players for the novice guidance system and the old players are not affected.
3、Season Early-Access continuation and the access and challenge reward updates. Already have a golden pass for the old players can be re-collected by email and the new players can be accumulated login activities by 3 days to obtain the golden pass free of charge.
4、Added the advanced account system. Owning it increases the warehouse ceiling, combat silver coin revenue, and weekly research and development experience cap.
5、The new mall system, products have been updated.
6、The creation of Tron Legacy skin custom function off the shelf. Players who already have skin will receive the appropriate vehicle’s Tron Legacy Skin Compensation after maintenance is over and will need to be collected via email.
7、Added a supply box system (testing). Players can get supply boxes by fighting. 	The Mall purchased M60A2 material box can open access to a variety of combat materials, permanent vehicles and camouflage.
Players get replenishment points through the battle and depending on the ranking can get a different number of points. A total of 30 points will automatically synthesize a supply box.
The following image is an overview of the general supply box, the quantity of each material obtained varies and it can be repeated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/b2c4a7cf8962da84eb43496ad92b5adaad4094eb.png[/img]
The following image is an overview of the M60A2 kit, where parachutes, camouflage and vehicle awards are unique items that are not repeated after obtaining them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/0b6c9a8878627faba71c6ce3f787f4351c70fc93.png[/img]
8、Fire control components are incorporated into combat equipment systems. Players can purchase Lv.1 fire-controlled parts directly and bring them to the battlefield. Lv.2 fire control components can be obtained through the battlefield and taken out of the battlefield, but also from the supply box directly.
9.Remove the output of the lv.3 fire control unit in combat
10.Added login supply box activities, updated the next day to open. During the event login can receive 3 M60A2 supply boxes, open the opportunity to obtain permanent M60A2 and M60A2 package.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/e964021f5655bba8d797782f954591f9e6db5180.png[/img]
11、The mall added M60A2 material box.
12、Added MGM-51A anti-tank missile (testing), only M60A2 is available.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/72c7faa687b3923a461a241489c1baf1db770a9e.png[/img]
13、Reduces the basic durability deduction value for all equipment when the battle is settled.
14、Reduced maintenance costs for additional armor.
15、 The group chat interface in the lobby is integrated into the private.

If you get any bugs or suggestions,please leave your comments under the Steam community post or E-mail us:publish@fantiangame.com for further feedback.Thank you for your support.

notes.title: 9.11 update note
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Maintenance time[/h1][/b]
9.11, 2020 10:00~13:00  Asia (UTC+8)
9.11, 2020 18:00~21:00   NA (UTC-8)
Specific maintenance time will be advanced or delayed as appropriate

[b][h1]Update content：[/h1][/b]
1.Added a Wartime Enhancement System, which will be improved after release, if needed.
2.Added a teammate location reminder at the edge of the screen.
3."Collective Action" will be temporarily removed to be tweaked slightly and bring in new elements.
4.Upon landing, players are informed of their objectives in the current mode.
5.Vehicle type will be displayed on the Teammate list 
6.Reminder of pre-battle player count has been improved.
7.The storm circle and parachuting area are now more discernible on map.
8.Rank points are now displayed correctly after players win in team mode.
9.Balance changes have been made for MK6, T55, and L1.

[b][h1]Wartime Enhancement System[/h1][/b]
Players receive "Combat EXP" in-game. Upon receiving specific amount of EXP, they can upgrade their vehicles. Each level grants 2 properties, capping at 5 levels. Players may select the properties that suit them best.
By dealing damage and destroying targets, players receive Combat EXP. When out of battle, you can acquire Combat EXP by gathering Combat Medals.
PS: After each game is over, the enhanced performance will be restored
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/402b10b4bc206702735520e3ab97d55631bc3a13.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/bcc64869158df20fc5df5aae07052d9f0d2e30ab.png[/img][/url]

Chance to acquire blue Combat Medals from the chests that randomly spawn on maps.

notes.title: 8.21 Asian service update note
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Maintenance time[/h1][/b]
8.21, 2020 9:00~12:00  Asia (UTC+8)
8.20, 2020 17:00~20:00   NA (UTC-8)
Specific maintenance time will be advanced or delayed as appropriate

[b][h1]Update content：[/h1][/b]
1. Added bonus attributes of props. All appearance props in the game will increase the research and development point gains obtained in battle.

2. The vehicle barrel is fixed, and no pick-up barrel is produced in the scene.

3. Optimized the marking system in the battle. After marking, a new season will start in the scene. The player's pass, challenge, ranking points, season level, season experience bonus, and season battle data will be reset.

4. The member system is temporarily offline, and public experience compensation will be issued to all players who have at least one member greater than level 1.

5. The original vehicle talent and accessories system has been revised. The player's vehicle level will be retained and can be used in the new vehicle growth system. A modified label is added at the top of the lobby to correspond to this new system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/cde7285b1238559977555cc14e60787fc6ca79ee.png[/img]

6. The mall system is updated, and now the products sold in the mall are permanent, no longer refreshed daily and weekly.

7. The default vehicle is changed. Now new players enter the game and have four vehicles: T55, M60, L1, and M109A1. LAV-25 can be obtained through cumulative login activities, and MK6 can be obtained through the new season pass. Once they have LAV-25 and MK6 The old players are not affected.

8. Newly added two activities, "Cumulative Login" and "Daily Online Reward";

9. Added "R&D experience", which can be obtained through battle, and can be directly exchanged for public experience with gold coins.

10. Light bar display.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/686675b7b78e4ad002b89d608662713ec7b09a98.jpg[/img]

11. Slightly accelerated the pace of shrinking circles in battle;

12. The terrain optimization of the battle scene;

13. Optimize the battle voice chat system;

14. The self-detonation time caused by the rollover has been extended from 10 seconds to 30 seconds;

15. Fixed other known bugs

If you get any bugs or suggestions,please leave your comments under the Steam community post or E-mail us:publish@fantiangame.com for further feedback.Thank you for your support.

notes.title: 3.20 update note
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Maintenance time[/h1][/b]
3.20, 2020 14:00~16:00  Asia (UTC+8)
3.19, 2020 22:00~3.20,  2:00   NA (UTC-8)
Specific maintenance time will be advanced or delayed as appropriate

[b][h1]Update content：[/h1][/b]
New play & Feature
1.The new machine gun system. Each tank is equipped with its own machine gun. Players press the space bar by default to use the machine gun in battle. Machine guns are less powerful and penetrating, but there are no ammunition limit. Continued use it will overheat and require cooling for a while before it can be used again.
2.The new tactical weapons system. There are three tactical weapons available. Smokescreen Bomb, it improved from the original smoke bomb. Grenades, which cause damage to target in range. EMP, blinding all targets in range and disabling tank information systems. The initial default of the battle carries Smokescreen Bombs.
3.Add UAV skill. After using it, reconnaissance aircraft can be sent to continuously detect a certain range of enemy units. It can be destroyed.
4.Add VEESS skill, using it after the vehicle will continue to release smoke. It will be changed when the vehicle moves and blocks the enemy’s view.
5.Add some commander voice prompts.
6.Add inactive penalty. For more than 30 days no single-player/team mode fights, a certain number of ladder points will be deducted according to the current level daily.

Adjustment & Optimization
1.Optimize bomber skills. You can now precisely select the start and end points of the release.

If you get any bugs or suggestions,please leave your comments under the Steam community post or E-mail us:publish@fantiangame.com for further feedback.Thank you for your support.

[b][h1]Update content：[/h1][/b]
New function and gameplay
1，New background for lobby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33681603/c717873260e72817d9bf2edb633acbb4cc044996.png[/img]
2，Camouflage composition system is back.Players can compose camouflages in the DIY screen with designated items.
3，Remove item：Turret Control.Add new item：Improved Fire Control to improve shooting accuracy.Add new item：Enhanced Turret Drive to improve turret’ rotation ability.
4，Add a display of barrel reloading time near the crosshair.
5，Ballistic dispersion is improved.
6，Add some new guidance for rookies.
7，Add a new effect——truesky， in higher quality for sky.It’s now only available for WIN10 operation system.And it' turned on by default but can be turned off in settings.

Adjustment and optimization
1，Optimize clouds’ effect while parachuting.
2，Optimize effects of “fire support” and “bomber calling” to make it plays more smoothly.
3，Optimize graphics of battle scenes to increase and stabilize the FPS.
4，Fix the problem that backpack module may not display after reconnecting.
5，Fix the problem that tress knocked down before may recover after reconnecting.
6，Optimize the tanks proficiency system.Now the max proficiency level becomes 7.If tanks proficiency level is above 7,it will goes down to 7.And we will make compensation to players with tanks like that in the following version.  
7,Now mines cant destroy transmission structure but the tanks’ tracks.
8,Optimize the effect and hit logic of ricochets.
9,Optimize some landform inside battlefields.

notes.title: November update prospect
notes.notes:
Fierce battles in 《Refight：Burning Engine》 keeps going，with deafening artillery resounds through the sky！Dear commanders，there will come a huge change in the November update.Brand new system and the shop revision will definitely bring all the players a new experience.We guess you guys cant wait for any longer,so we are going to offer you the test interface.Specific circumstances take the actual assembly version as the criterion.

[h1][b]Battle Pass[/b][/h1]

You can get corresponding reward when your battle pass reach the specified level.
Reward include kinds of items,and the battle pass counts to 100

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/5f1b60d06249b4e281692cb2c5edb677901e3e21.png[/img]

[h1][b]Challenges[/b][/h1]

Challenges contain rookies challenges,season challenges,battle pass challenges and week challenges(10 weeks)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/dd730c43e8042082ee23def87a2f019049efa1ea.png[/img]

[h1][b]Time-Limited Shop[/b][/h1]

Various items will be put on the shelf in time-limited shop.Shop items can only be bought wit gold.Players can choose according to your preference.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/60c80b78c9d8a88401383e26c9526b2126a4e01e.png[/img]

[h1][b] Halloween exclusive parachutes and weight boxes[/b][/h1]

We are to push out new parachutes and weight boxes with Halloween elements for you to show out your personality and share holiday atmosphere.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/a721fb7393c9ec8278340f0ce2b2253588c0a4a3.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/fc6cb6bc71d6ab2e95f61051e8ac478f064b2858.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/53f843a31e9f797d569c777693c04ff07cc868e5.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/6c077ab81bbc3a524d658a1957ed4d5ed7e0ad07.png[/img]

[h1] [b]moji functione[/b][/h1]

Warlords also have feelings!Players can use different emoji to express your feelings.
Emoji can be get from battle pass upgrade,challenges and shop.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/caa3ca5301655b2a925a7572d523a492e77fd5ca.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/2f6cad463dcc5c429d995b5f8646fe94a65a2aeb.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33681603/61a67efaa716d703ed3ee483fa0a3f93719b31e6.png[/img]
